title: Atlas Energy Solutions Stock Surges on Power Deal With ‘Leading Frontier AI Lab’
summary: An artificial intelligence firm is financially backing part of  Atlas Energy Solutions  ’ data-center power buildout, Atlas announced Friday.  Shares of Atlas surged 17% to $12.85, pacing toward their largest increase since Oct. 29, 2025, and they briefly traded at a record pace of 21% earlier in the session, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Atlas said it reached two cost-reimbursement agreements with the AI lab to purchase equipment and power generation capabilities for data center projects.
